# Gustiamo

> > Gustiamo curates authentic artisan Italian food products from small-scale producers across Italy's regions, specializing in traditional pasta, olive oils, balsamic vinegars, and regional specialties.

Founded to connect American food lovers with Italy's finest artisan producers, Gustiamo sources directly from family farms and traditional makers in Sicily, Puglia, Campania, Veneto, and other Italian regions. The site features products from legendary artisans like Pastificio Martelli, Pasticceria Biasetto, and Caffè Sicilia, emphasizing quality ingredients made using centuries-old techniques.

## Key Topics

- Artisan Italian food producers
- Regional Italian specialties (Sicily, Puglia, Campania, Veneto, Friuli)
- Bronze-die pasta and ancient grain varieties
- Traditional balsamic vinegar from Reggio Emilia
- Extra virgin olive oil (EVOO)
- Cerignola and Castelvetrano olives
- Pasticceria Biasetto panettone and colomba
- Caffè Sicilia Noto almond products
- Tumminia and ancient grain pasta
- Italian gift baskets and curated boxes
- Mediterranean Diet ingredients
- Gragnano IGP pasta
- Acquerello Carnaroli risotto rice
- Italian coffee roasters
- Katie Parla Roman cuisine

## Artisan Pasta & Ancient Grains

- [Fusilli di Pisa Martelli](https://www.gustiamo.com/fusilli-by-martelli): Bronze-die fusilli pasta by legendary Pastificio Martelli from Tuscany
- [Tumminia Busiate - 500 gr - 17.6 oz](https://www.gustiamo.com/busiate-tumminia): Sicilian ancient grain busiate pasta by Molini del Ponte
- [Lasagna Faella](https://www.gustiamo.com/lasagna-faella-gragnano-pasta-campania): IGP Gragnano lasagna by Pasta Faella, bronze-die cut from Campania

## Balsamic Vinegars & Wine Vinegars

- [Valpolicella Red Wine Vinegar (Aceto di Vino Rosso](https://www.gustiamo.com/valpolicella-wine-vinegar-by-hazan-allegrini): Oak-aged Valpolicella red wine vinegar from Veneto by IMA Wine Vinegar

## Olives & Preserved Vegetables
